# Workitem 05 — Create Reinforcement Learning Week

## Purpose

When Swamy starts reinforcement learning, create a fresh four-layer week bundle under `src/weekN/`.

## Scope

- Create content only when the week is active.
- Use preserved reference material only for understanding.
- Do not migrate archived text or notebooks directly.

## Target Bundle

- `src/weekN/01-notes/reinforcement-learning.md`
- `src/weekN/02-quizzes/reinforcement-learning-quiz.md`
- `src/weekN/03-notebooks/reinforcement-learning-implementation.ipynb`
- `src/weekN/04-discussions/reinforcement-learning-discussion.md`

## Acceptance Criteria

- Notes explain agent, environment, state, action, reward, policy, and value in plain English.
- Quiz questions are original and answer explanations are consistent.
- Notebook implementation is from scratch at the core algorithm level.
- Discussion uses original worked scenarios.
- CI and markdown lint pass.
